test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Formidable'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Formidable - **In this context, "formidable" is the most suitable word.
 
• **It implies** that Narad was greatly respected or feared for his devoutness because he was very intense or capable.
 
• So,* "he was a formidable devotee of Lord Vishnu*" **makes sense** and fits the context perfectly.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *With his slight build and his simple white clothes, Narad looked harmless, but he had quite a reputation. He had powerful family connections and was a **formidable** devotee of Lord Vishnu. His favourite (4) ________ was to travel from court to court and world to world, collecting gossip and (5) ________ mayhem.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Here's the explanation for the other options:
 
 
• **Brooding -** This term typically refers to someone who is in deep thought about something that makes them unhappy or angry. In this context, it doesn't fit because Narad is described as a devotee, and brooding doesn't accurately describe his devotion.
 
• **Pleasant -** This adjective is used to describe something that is enjoyable or attractive. While a person can be a pleasant devotee, in the context of the sentence, it doesn't quite convey the intensity of Narad's devotion to Lord Vishnu.
 
• **Peasant -** This term refers to a poor farmer who owns or rents a small piece of land for cultivation. It is not related to the context of devotion or religious dedication, so it doesn't fit in this sentence.
